name: Special Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Meeting of the City
  Council of the City of Artesia to be held at Artesia City Hall, at 4:00 P.M. on
Thursday, December 5, 2019, for the purpose of considering two tax measures as
  described on the agenda.

  A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701

  REMOTE TELECONFERENCE LOCATION:
  THE MERITAGE RESORT AND SPA, ROOM NO. 100
  875 BORDEAUX WAY
  NAPA, CA 94558

  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2019
  4:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS
This time is for members of the public to address the City Council on Staff Report Item
No. 1. Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council should fill out a speaker card and
give that card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the commencement of the meeting.
Please observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when giving your presentation.

STAFF REPORTS

  1. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTIONS TO CALL A SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  AND OTHER RELATED ACTIONS TO PLACE ON THE MARCH 3, 2020 BALLOT
  A 3/4% GENERAL TRANSACTIONS AND USE (SALES) TAX MEASURE, AND
  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTIONS TO CALL A REGULAR MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  TO PLACE ON THE NOVEMBER 3, 2020 BALLOT A GENERAL TAX MEASURE
  ESTABLISHING A TAX ON CANNABIS BUSINESSES OPERATING WITHIN
  THE CITY OF ARTESIA
  STAFF REPORT ATTACHMENT ATTACHMENT ATTACHMENT ATTACHMENT
  ATTACHMENT ATTACHMENT

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or other
issues of concern to City Council members that may briefly be presented at this time.

ADJOURNMENT
 The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate
in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to these
proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device (ALD) from the City Clerk. If you require said device, please come
forward to the City Clerk at the staff table for assistance.
minutes_text:
CITY OF ARTESIA
  ARTESIA CITY HALL, ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  REMOTE TELECONFERENCE LOCATION:
  THE MERITAGE RESORT AND SPA, ROOM NO. 100
  875 BORDEAUX WAY
  NAPA, CA 94558

  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2019
  4:00 P.M.
The Special Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 4:00 p.m., on Thursday,
December 5, 2019 in the Artesia City Council Chambers by Mayor Pro Tem Canales.

 PRESENT:  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember
  Rene Trevino, Councilmember
  Ali Taj, Councilmember (Remote Teleconference Location)
  Miguel Canales, Mayor Pro Tem

 ABSENT:  Tony Lima, Mayor

 ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Todd Leishman, City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistance City Clerk
  Melissa Burke, Administrative Manager

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TREVINO TO APPROVE THE AGENDA.

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO.

  Said motion carried (4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Trevino, Taj and Canales
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Lima
  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 4-0-0-1.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS

  City Clerk presented the announcement and reported that there were no Public
  Comments.

STAFF REPORTS
   1. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTIONS TO CALL A SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  AND OTHER RELATED ACTIONS TO PLACE ON THE MARCH 3, 2020 BALLOT
  A 3/4% GENERAL TRANSACTIONS AND USE (SALES) TAX MEASURE, AND
  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTIONS TO CALL A REGULAR MUNICIPAL ELECTION
  TO PLACE ON THE NOVEMBER 3, 2020 BALLOT A GENERAL TAX MEASURE
  ESTABLISHING A TAX ON CANNABIS BUSINESSES OPERATING WITHIN
  THE CITY OF ARTESIA

  City Manager provided Staff Report.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 19-2780, 19-
  2781, 19-2782, 19-2786, 19-2787 AND 19-2788.

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER TREVINO.
  Said motion carried (4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Ramoso, Trevino, Taj and Canales
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Lima

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Item No. 1 was approved without objection 4-0-0-1.

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Canales provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Tem Canales adjourned the Special Meeting at 4:10pm
